items.description: There’s 100% a kind of mania you can get into with coding agents, where it feels like you’re getting a lot done and working all the time but nothing is really happening. I think it's often a form of avoidance of something else in life.
items.description_zh: 对于编码代理来说，你百分百会陷入一种狂热，感觉自己已经完成了很多工作并且一直在工作，但实际上什么也没发生。我认为这通常是逃避生活中其他事情的一种形式。
